narrative: Neil Maxwell contributed to Agroverse, Cypher Defense, Rotten Radish, and TrueSight DAO from August 2022 to March 2024. His efforts centered on Bring Builders, where he brought on active contributors four times, alongside human effort logged for three hours at 100 TDG per hour. He also engaged in Build Game strategy work by reviewing a proposed strategy with a clear improvement suggestion, suggesting an idea without implementation details, and participating in an online poll vote.
